9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Greater Manchester trial targets prolific shoplifters with new programme Rochdale
    A new initiative in Greater Manchester aims to tackle prolific shoplifting through coordinated efforts from police, probation services, and local councils.
  • Rochdale AFC launches Christmas Toy Appeal for local families in need Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC is calling on fans to donate gifts for its Christmas Toy Appeal, aiming to support local children living in poverty this festive season.
  • Person dies on tracks at Todmorden station, disrupting services to Rochdale Rochdale
    A person has died on the tracks at Todmorden station, affecting train services between Rochdale and Hebden Bridge.
  • Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood Heywood
    Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.
  • St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale placed in special measures after Ofsted inspection Rochdale
    St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale has been placed in special measures following an Ofsted inspection that highlighted serious safety issues and a lack of effective leadership.
  • Winter Wood Grotto returns to Rochdale with new show themed 'The Wild' Rochdale
    The Winter Wood Grotto, a festive tradition in Rochdale, is back with a new woodland-themed show created by Cornwall’s Rogue Otherworld.
  • Rochdale Borough Council establishes Integrated Commissioning Board Rochdale
    Rochdale Borough Council has established the Integrated Commissioning Board to enhance health and social care services across the borough.
  • Rochdale AFC reduces ticket prices for FA Cup tie against Newport County Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC has announced reduced ticket prices for their FA Cup match against Newport County on 5 December at Crown Oil Arena.
  • Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood Heywood
    Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

Weather: Sunny 7°C in Rochdale today.

9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Greater Manchester trial targets prolific shoplifters with new programme (Rochdale). A new initiative in Greater Manchester aims to tackle prolific shoplifting through coordinated efforts from police, probation services, and local councils.

Rochdale AFC launches Christmas Toy Appeal for local families in need (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC is calling on fans to donate gifts for its Christmas Toy Appeal, aiming to support local children living in poverty this festive season.

Person dies on tracks at Todmorden station, disrupting services to Rochdale (Rochdale). A person has died on the tracks at Todmorden station, affecting train services between Rochdale and Hebden Bridge.

Christmas carols with Mustard Seed Church, Heywood (Heywood). Mustard Seed Church in Heywood is holding a Christmas carol morning on Sunday 20 December, starting at 9.30am, at Ian's Gate, to the rear of 193 Manchester Road.

St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale placed in special measures after Ofsted inspection (Rochdale). St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale has been placed in special measures following an Ofsted inspection that highlighted serious safety issues and a lack of effective leadership.

Winter Wood Grotto returns to Rochdale with new show themed 'The Wild' (Rochdale). The Winter Wood Grotto, a festive tradition in Rochdale, is back with a new woodland-themed show created by Cornwall’s Rogue Otherworld.

Rochdale Borough Council establishes Integrated Commissioning Board (Rochdale). Rochdale Borough Council has established the Integrated Commissioning Board to enhance health and social care services across the borough.

Rochdale AFC reduces ticket prices for FA Cup tie against Newport County (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC has announced reduced ticket prices for their FA Cup match against Newport County on 5 December at Crown Oil Arena.

Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood (Heywood). Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

Weather: Sunny 7°C in Rochdale today.
